ja: • 323系はＪＲ西日本が2013年度から推進する「大阪環状線改善プロジェクト」の一環として、「安全・安心の向上」「機器の信頼性向上（安定輸送）」「情報提供の充実」「人に優しい快適な車内空間」などを重視して開発された通勤電車。
• 2016～2018年度にかけて168両（21編成）が製造され、大阪環状線・桜島線に順次投入される予定。
en: • The 323 series is a commuter train developed as part of the "Osaka Loop Line Improvement Project" promoted by JR Nishimoto since 2013, with emphasis on "improving safety and security," "improving equipment reliability (stable transportation)," "enhancing information provision," and "comfortable interior space that is friendly to people."
• 168 cars (21 formations) will be manufactured between 2016 and 2018, and will be sequentially introduced on the Osaka Loop Line and Sakurajima Line.
